description: Generate hierarchy, focus interaction and exact copy (REQ-024; C51, G16; R06, R10, R11, R21, R23, R25; V01, V02; AC-C51-01, AC-R024-01..08; JOURNEY-024), reconciling UAT #286. A3 TASK-119 (2026-11-23) carries these checks onto Round 7 (decisions 4 and 6 of 2026-11-13; owner decision 4 of 2026-11-18); case names unchanged. On the real /generate route Goal and Focus lead the one card in Round 7's two-column Goal/Focus summary (.clr-v4-program-summary, src/ui/workout-experience-presentation.css): the Focus value is itself the change control, a keyboard disclosure (a text action named Change focus that shows the value, with aria-expanded/aria-controls and the text action's chevron cue), so no detached or paired Change focus remains; Recovery is reached inside the choices it opens as its own session toggle, apart from the four mutually exclusive movement focuses, stays in view with its note when the choices close while it is on (owner decision 4), and is never recommended or selected for a first workout, nor banned; Place and Notes carry no helper lines while labels, controls, the Notes placeholder, errors and the request are unchanged; MINUTES fits through the shared public Input unit contract (src/styles/fields.css); the title is Generate and the action Generate workout; Back stays the shared framed icon-only control named Home. #286's contracts are kept: first-workout explicit required Anchor, collapsed recommended Focus with a one-workout override, stored Goal, Intensity 1-10. The accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=screens (bec4454) composes its own Generate card from the same Round 7 parts over memory only (framed icon-only Back, the Generate title, the goal above the Focus value that opens the choices, the MINUTES field, Generate workout); its gallery cases read that card, and the reads it cannot meet (Notes, Recovery apart from the focuses, the first-workout switch) are proved on the route and listed in TASK-119's test ledger. check-01 runs the whole of src/app/Generate.test.tsx and requires the named TASK-024 cases; check-02 proves the route in the browser at 320 and 390 with a contained synthetic session: touch, keyboard, reduced motion, reload, a first workout, a failed generation keeping the draft, and the gallery state. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-024 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/app/Generate.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
